subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale guard assertions are repaired and the final head is green, should these grouped third-party action revisions be approved across credential-bearing, security-scanning, publishing, and Codex-agent workflows?
rationale: The assertion repair is mechanical, but accepting replacement executable revisions across protected automation surfaces requires maintainer trust and ownership judgment that test results alone cannot supply.

options.title: Approve after repaired checks
options.body: Accept the verified grouped revisions after all four guard assertions move atomically and final exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker, and Codex action updates into narrower trust-review units.

options.title: Hold the dependency group
options.body: Keep the grouped update open until owners have additional upstream or operational confidence.

recommendation.title: Approve after repaired checks
recommendation.body: Accept the verified grouped revisions after all four guard assertions move atomically and final exact-head checks pass.
